content: {"like":["Enjoys classic 1950s courtroom dramas like *12 Angry Men*","Prefers well-crafted 1980s monster and sci‑fi B‑movies such as *Warriors of the Lost World*","Values special features and behind‑the‑scenes content in cult series like MST3K","Appreciates strong performances in superhero films, e.g., *Logan*","Likes animated children’s series with high energy, e.g., *Gummi Bears*"],"dislike":["Dislikes films with overt political bias, such as pro‑Serbian WWI narratives","Finds unwatchable low‑budget horror like *The Corpse Vanishes* frustrating","Criticizes over‑dramatic presenters in documentary‑style shows","Rejects poorly written sequels, e.g., *Deathstalker III*","Dislikes shows that lose core characters, like *McMillan & Wife* Season 6"]}
